root_cause.text: The original code used short-circuit evaluation in a logical OR condition with `test_and_clear_bit()`, so when the first condition was true, the remaining `test_and_clear_bit()` calls were skipped, leaving some conditional effect bits uncleared and causing NULL pointer dereferences when those bits were later used.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes the condition from `if (test_and_clear_bit(FF_SPRING, ...) || test_and_clear_bit(FF_DAMPER, ...) || ...)` to a sequence that unconditionally clears all four bits by accumulating results into a boolean variable (`test |= test_and_clear_bit(...)`). The commit message states that "NULL pointer dereferences were happening because not all the conditional effects bits were cleared."
